name: Daring Infiltrator
summary: Not known for their flashy entrances or for standing out in a crowd, a daring infiltrator uses stealth, disguise, and ruthless guile to pursue her goals.
replacesText: Class Skills; Bonus Feat; Swashbuckler Initiative; Menacing Swordplay; Bleeding Wound
mechanicalNotes: Replacement progression is automated. Bespoke effects without a shared builder subsystem remain descriptive.

features.name: Class Skills
features.summary: A daring infiltrator gains Disguise and Stealth as class skills, but does not gain Diplomacy, Perform, and Profession as class skills. This alters the swashbuckler’s class skill list.

features.name: Bonus Feats
features.summary: In addition to combat feats, a daring infiltrator’s bonus feats at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, and 20th level can come from the following list: Alertness, Antagonize UM , Cosmopolitan APG , Deceitful, Deft Hands, Disarming Threat*, Persuasive, Prodigy UM , and Skill Focus. (Those marked with an asterisk [*] are detailed in this book.) This alters the bonus feat class ability.

features.name: Quick-Tongued (Ex)
features.summary: At 2nd level, a daring infiltrator gains a +1 bonus on Bluff checks. This bonus increases by 1 for every 4 levels beyond 2nd. This ability replaces charmed life.

features.name: Deeds
features.summary: A daring infiltrator gains the following deeds, each of which replaces an existing deed. Clandestine Expertise (Ex) : At 3rd level, a daring infiltrator with at least 1 panache point gains a +2 bonus on Disguise and Stealth checks. Also, as long as she has at least 1 panache point, when she successfully aids another with a Disguise or Stealth check, she grants the subject a +4 bonus on the skill check instead of the normal +2. This deed replaces swashbuckler initiative. Silence Is Golden (Ex) : At 3rd level, when a daring infiltrator with at least 1 panache point succeeds at a trip or grapple combat maneuver check, the target is rendered mute for 1 round. For every 5 by which the result of the combat maneuver check exceeds the opponent’s CMD, the target remains mute for an additional round. A mute creature cannot speak, use language-dependent effects or verbal components, or use command words. This deed replaces menacing swordplay. Authoritative Bluff (Ex) : At 11th level, a daring infiltrator can spend 1 panache point to reroll a Bluff check after the roll is made but before the results are revealed. She must take the result of the second roll, even if it is lower. Additionally, a daring infiltrator with at least 1 panache point gains a +5 bonus on Bluff checks to pretend to be someone’s superior (socially or in the military). If she succeeds at the check, the target obeys any reasonable orders she gives as it would those of an actual superior in the situation. This deed replaces bleeding wound.
